Issue Goodwill points

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Note:
>
> By default, auto approve is enabled for points issual.
>
> To successfully credit goodwill points, you must ensure that the Points Adjustment Settings toggle is ON and a Default Till is configured. If either setting is missing, the system will approve the request but will not credit points to the customer.
>
> When auto-approval is enabled, the system also requires a Goodwill Point Expiry Strategy to be configured for the relevant program. The expiry strategy must have the goodwill option enabled. If no such strategy exists, the request will remain in Pending status and points will not be credited. In this case, you may see an error code 3002 (GOODWILL\_EXPIRY\_STRATEGY\_NOT\_FOUND).
